title: Participate in Its Conversion
excerpt: You don’t have to give up on Christian faith. Nor do you have to accept it as it is. Christian faith can be saved, and you are invited to participate in its conversion. – The Great Spiritual Migration (available September 20, 2016) Tour info here: /archive
body:
You don’t have to give up on Christian faith. Nor do you have to accept it as it is. Christian faith can be saved, and you are invited to participate in its conversion.
